Healthcare Large Industrial Campuses Parcel Delivery Empowering caregivers to focus on what matters most, patient care Free up 40% of nursing time currently spent on non-clinical tasks by automating essential deliveries throughout hospitals, labs, and pharmacies. Our robots handle medical supplies, laboratory samples, medications, and linens with secure, contactless precision, reducing contamination risks while ensuring critical materials reach their destination on time, every time. Learn More Streamlining logistics across sprawling facilities and complex environments Navigate massive campuses spanning hundreds of acres with autonomous precision. From manufacturing plants to research facilities, our robots eliminate the inefficiencies of human-powered transport across long distances, multiple buildings, and challenging outdoor conditions, delivering everything from parts and tools to documents and meals. Learn More Revolutionizing last-mile logistics with autonomous efficiency Transform the most expensive segment of delivery, the last mile, which represents over 50% of total shipping costs, with autonomous robots that operate around the clock. Perfect for urban deliveries, campus distributions, and high-density residential areas where traditional delivery faces parking, traffic, and accessibility challenges. Contact Us Backed By Introducing Ottumn.AI Ottumn.AI is Ottonomy’s cloud-based orchestration platform designed to unify modular robots and smart infrastructure into a single intelligent system. Built on neurosymbolic AI and edge-to-cloud architecture, Ottumn.AI extends Ottonomy’s autonomy capabilities across healthcare, industrial, and urban environments. Explore Ottumn.AI Ottonomy® robots are transforming healthcare, e-commerce, pharma, and enterprise campuses with seamless, autonomous deliveries for intralogistics and last mile needs. Our fully autonomous robots safely deliver medicines, lab samples, retail packages, and critical materials—curbside, across campuses, and even within facilities—maximizing efficiency and reliability. © 2021-2026 Ottonomy.IO:: Autonomous Delivery Robots. Our fully autonomous robots can deliver food & beverages, groceries, and packages to curbside, last mile, and even indoor environments. Ottonomy robots are available on a “RaaS” (Robotics as a Service) model. Our business customers get access to a quicker, safer, and more economical delivery option as compared to traditional 3rd party delivery services.
